name: magazine-cover
title: Magazine Cover
description: A manga magazine cover in a 3:4 case: the masthead in the SFX face across a band of ink at the top with an optional tagline, the issue and date in a box at its end, cover lines on paper plates down both sides of the art (one may be an accent flat for the big news) and a headline plate at the foot. Every word rests on a flat, never on the art. The lettering scales with the cover (container units), from a thumbnail to full width on a phone. Static, a link (href) or a button (onSelect) with the hover lift, ink focus ring and pressed offset.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/magazine-cover". The art is an image URL (give imageAlt) or any node; it fills the whole cover, under the masthead band and the plates. Without art a screentone is drawn. Keep cover lines short: they take at most half the width each.

meta.tagline: A magazine cover: masthead, issue, cover lines around the art.
meta.usage:
import { MagazineCover } from "@/components/manga/magazine-cover"

<MagazineCover
  title="Weekly Ink"
  issue="No. 12"
  date="Spring"
  image="/covers/12.jpg"
  imageAlt="A rookie in front of a huge sun"
  lines={[{ text: "New series!", highlight: true }, { text: "Bonus poster", side: "end" }]}
  headline="The rookie's first page"
/>

props.name: issue
props.description: Issue number, in the box at the band's end.

props.name: date
props.description: Date or season under the issue.

props.name: tagline
props.description: A short line under the masthead.

props.name: image
props.description: Image URL or any node, filling the cover. Without it, a screentone.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alternative text of an image URL.

props.name: lines
props.description: Cover lines on plates around the art. highlight: an accent flat.

props.name: headline
props.description: The main cover line, on a plate at the foot.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the cover, e.g. its width.
